episode_title: 今日雙語精華：太空保衛戰、關稅風暴與政治法庭戲碼！
episode_summary: 歡迎收聽二零二六年十一月二十六日的雙語精華！本集收錄：一、人類首次成功改變小行星軌道的壯舉，最新影像揭示驚人撞擊坑。二、美國對多國祭出新關稅，全球貿易戰火再起？三、以色列總理納坦雅胡的貪腐案出現轉折，法官建議撤銷部分重罪指控。一起來聽聽網友們的爆笑或犀利觀點！

selected_links.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu

segments.zh: 嗨，各位聽眾，歡迎收聽二零二六年十一月二十六日的每日五分鐘雙語精華。
segments.en: Hey everyone, welcome to today's five-minute bilingual daily digest on November twenty-sixth, two thousand twenty-six.

segments.zh: 我是你們的主持人，今天我們要聊聊人類的太空防禦、全球貿易戰，還有政治人物的法庭戲碼。
segments.en: I'm your host, and today we'll discuss humanity's space defense, global trade wars, and political courtroom dramas.

segments.zh: 準備好了嗎？跟我們一起用中英雙語，輕鬆掌握全球脈動吧！
segments.en: Ready? Let's effortlessly grasp global happenings with our bilingual segments!

segments.zh: 首先，來看看一個超酷的科學新聞，關於我們地球的太空防禦計畫。
segments.en: First up, let's dive into some super cool science news about our planet's space defense program.

segments.zh: 四年前，NASA的DART任務成功撞擊了小行星Dimorphos，改變了它的軌道。
segments.en: Four years ago, NASA's DART mission successfully impacted the asteroid Dimorphos, altering its orbit.

segments.zh: 最新影像顯示，這次撞擊在小行星表面留下了一個體育場大小的巨大隕石坑。
segments.en: New images reveal the impact left a stadium-sized crater on the asteroid's surface.

segments.zh: 這證明了人類確實有能力保護地球，避免未來可能的小行星撞擊危機。
segments.en: This proves humanity can indeed protect Earth from potential future asteroid impact threats.

segments.zh: Reddit網友們都嗨翻了，有人說：「別惹地球，我們有太空武器！」
segments.en: Reddit users are thrilled, with one saying: "Don't mess with Earth, we have space weapons!"

segments.zh: 也有人開玩笑說：「希望我們撞的是對的石頭，而不是讓它偏向我們。」
segments.en: Others joked: "Hope we hit the right rock, and didn't just steer it towards us instead."

segments.zh: 這次任務真是太振奮人心了，讓我們對未來充滿希望。
segments.en: This mission is truly inspiring, filling us with great hope for the future.

segments.zh: 感覺就像是科幻電影情節，但這次它是真實發生的呢！
segments.en: It feels like a sci-fi movie plot, but this time, it's actually happening!

segments.zh: 人類文明又向前邁進了一大步，真棒。
segments.en: Human civilization has taken another huge leap forward, which is fantastic.

segments.zh: 接下來，我們把焦點轉向國際經濟，美國宣布對多國祭出新的關稅。
segments.en: Next, let's shift our focus to international economics, as the US announced new tariffs on several countries.

segments.zh: 這次受影響的包括中國和歐盟等美國主要貿易夥伴。
segments.en: Key US trading partners, including China and the EU, are among those affected this time.

segments.zh: 這消息一出，全球股市都緊張了起來，大家都在觀望後續影響。
segments.en: This news has global stock markets on edge, with everyone watching for subsequent effects.

segments.zh: Reddit網友們對此議論紛紛，有人擔心這會引發新一輪的貿易戰。
segments.en: Reddit users are buzzing about this, with some worrying it will trigger a new round of trade wars.

segments.zh: 有人質疑：「這些關稅最終會由誰來買單？還不是消費者嗎？」
segments.en: Someone questioned: "Who ultimately pays for these tariffs? Isn't it just the consumers?"

segments.zh: 也有人認為，這是保護國內產業的必要手段，雖然短期會有陣痛。
segments.en: Others believe it's a necessary measure to protect domestic industries, despite short-term pain.

segments.zh: 無論如何，這都將對全球供應鏈和物價產生深遠的影響。
segments.en: Regardless, this will have a profound impact on global supply chains and prices.

segments.zh: 貿易政策的角力，總是牽動著每個人的荷包啊。
segments.en: The struggle over trade policies always affects everyone's wallets.

segments.zh: 希望各國能找到平衡點，避免不必要的經濟衝擊。
segments.en: Hopefully, countries can find a balance to avoid unnecessary economic shocks.

segments.zh: 最後，來看看一則國際政治新聞，關於以色列總理納坦雅胡的貪腐案。
segments.en: Finally, let's look at an international political news story regarding Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's corruption case.

segments.zh: 根據報導，以色列法官建議撤銷對他最嚴重的幾項指控。
segments.en: According to reports, Israeli judges recommended dropping the most serious charges against him.

segments.zh: 這讓納坦雅胡鬆了一口氣，他表示這場審判應該就此結束了。
segments.en: This comes as a relief to Netanyahu, who stated that his trial should now conclude.

segments.zh: 但這也引發了外界對司法獨立性和政治影響的討論。
segments.en: However, this has also sparked discussions about judicial independence and political influence.

segments.zh: Reddit上，許多網友對此持懷疑態度，覺得政治人物總能全身而退。
segments.en: On Reddit, many users are skeptical, feeling politicians always manage to get off scot-free.

segments.zh: 有人諷刺說：「看吧，權力果然是最好的辯護律師。」
segments.en: One sarcastically commented: "See, power truly is the best defense lawyer."

segments.zh: 也有人認為，如果證據不足，撤銷指控是符合司法程序的。
segments.en: Others argued that if evidence is insufficient, dropping charges aligns with legal procedure.

segments.zh: 無論結果如何，這都再次提醒我們，政治世界從來不缺戲劇性。
segments.en: Regardless of the outcome, this again reminds us that the political world is never short of drama.

segments.zh: 期待後續發展，看這場政治大戲如何收場。
segments.en: We look forward to further developments, to see how this political drama concludes.

segments.zh: 好的，今天的每日五分鐘雙語精華就到這裡告一段落。
segments.en: Alright, that brings us to the end of today's five-minute bilingual daily digest.

segments.zh: 感謝您的收聽，別忘了訂閱我們的頻道，我們下次節目再見囉！
segments.en: Thank you for listening, don't forget to subscribe to our channel, and we'll catch you next time!
